<br>
<br>

This guide and examples have been designed to meet the requirements of:

* STARS reproducibility recommendations
* NHS levels of rap

You can find out more about these and how to meet them.
we meet them... help you meet them!

<br>

**New to this stuff?** We have some background pages explaining some of these concepts:

* DES - what a DES model is
* RAP - defining reproducibility and RAPs, what they are, why to do them
* FOSS - explaining what FOSS is, why we use it, and why we use SimPy and simmer for our examples

<br>

This resource has been developed as part of the STARs project. find out more go to the [stars website]().
